items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: I heard Mamie Smith sing that song.

ctx.x: Well, we'll turn the machine off. Way back down.
Where did you learn Trouble Trouble? Well, I heard that number at a place, Cabaret. They call it Entertainer's Cabaret. I heard Mamie Smith sing that song. Trouble Trouble. I've had it all my days.
